name: Can a Lazy Susan be installed in any corner kitchen cabinet?

mainEntity.name: Can a Lazy Susan be installed in any corner kitchen cabinet?

acceptedAnswer.text: While most standard corner kitchen cabinets can accommodate a Lazy Susan, not all are ideally suited without modifications. Diagonal corner cabinets are generally easiest to fit with full-round units. Blind corner cabinets, which have an inaccessible space, often require kidney-shaped or pull-out Lazy Susan systems designed to bring the shelves forward. The internal dimensions, door opening, and presence of obstacles like plumbing or structural elements will determine feasibility. A professional assessment can confirm if your specific cabinet is compatible and what type of Lazy Susan would work best.
